name: Facet
text:
Build the Excava interface in Figma as a clickable prototype first. It lets us test navigation, hierarchy, and interaction flows without coding, which speeds up iteration and exposes UX flaws early. The trade-off is that Figma can’t show live data behavior, so we’ll need a second phase to validate real-time updates.

Done.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A Figma prototype risks anchoring us to a static vision—users will expect the polished mockup to match the final product, not a placeholder. A live HTML/CSS prototype forces us to confront real constraints upfront, exposing performance and data-handling gaps before they become technical debt. Settle it by building a minimal, functional version first; if it fails to meet speed or clarity goals, we iterate.
